description: This file defines an abstract base class for LLM provider adapters in a machine learning or AI project. It specifies the interface and some common functionalities for adapter subclasses that integrate different LLM providers, including methods for message handling, tools conversion, and invocation parameter extraction.

classes.name: BaseLLMAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class for LLM provider-specific adapters, defining methods for message processing, tools conversion, and LLM invocation.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Abstract property to get the identifier string used for LLM-specific messages.

methods.name: TLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext, **kwargs)
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain provider-specific invocation parameters from an LLM context.

methods.name: List[Any] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a standardized tools schema into the provider-specific format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve messages from an LLM context in a format suitable for logging.

methods.name: LLMSpecificMessage create_llm_specific_message(self, message: Any)
methods.description: Creates a new LLMSpecificMessage instance for a given message.

methods.name: List[LLMContextMessage] get_messages(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Retrieves messages, including LLM-specific ones, from the context.

methods.name: List[Any]|NotGiven from_standard_tools(self, tools: Any)
methods.description: Converts tools from a standard format to provider format or returns as-is if not in standard format.

ctags.name: from_standard_tools
ctags.pattern: /^    def from_standard_tools(self, tools: Any) -> List[Any] | NotGiven:$/

ctags.name: get_messages_for_logging
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
